requirements: Use exactly the eight frozen comparator source pins.
Construct one isolated environment per comparator.
Network access is permitted only as required to obtain the frozen source pins and dependencies during environment construction.
Smoke testing must use dedicated noncanonical toy fixtures only.
Do not generate or inspect the canonical 150-scenario benchmark dataset.
Record exact source commit or release, dependency versions, environment identity, commands, stdout, stderr, wall time and peak memory where applicable.
Capture POUTINE help output and resolve its exact non-GWAS homoplasy command and required input paths before canonical execution.
Resolve and freeze the exact PastML machine-readable ancestral-state output or API before canonical execution.
Validate tool-specific input and output adapters against smoke-test outputs without access to canonical benchmark truth.
If installation or smoke execution fails, preserve the attempted command, stdout, stderr and environment metadata.
Do not silently alter parameters, source pins, adapters or tool source to obtain a successful result; any remediation requiring such a change must be separately frozen.
